name: Delivery tickets to data
summary: Turns paper delivery tickets into rows in the business's own ticket register, checks each grade against the contract, and queues a QC email for approval when a grade is wrong. Crons read and draft; a person approves every send.

log-and-timber-export-receival.evidence: 1 discovery call describes this way of receiving delivery tickets (about 500,000 tons a year across 9 to 10 sites)

covered_by.ticket-capture: intake (dockets emailed in); the paper docket itself is read by a person
covered_by.ticket-entry: skill (docket fields entered in the shell), then record
covered_by.grade-and-quality: check (grade against the contract) and approval (QC email)
covered_by.record-keeping: record (register row in the business's workbook)

crons.name: intake
crons.summary: Docket emails in the ticket mailbox become new tickets. Reads only.

crons.name: record
crons.summary: Complete new tickets get a row in the ticket register. Incomplete ones are held with the reason.

crons.name: grade-check
crons.summary: Recorded tickets whose grade differs from the contract get a QC row and a QC email queued for approval.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations reach nobody outside the business: reads of the ticket mailbox, rows in the business's own ticket and QC tables, and an email draft. Sending the QC email is a live operation and waits for a person.

microsoft-365.covers: docket emails in, ticket register row, QC row, QC email draft and approved send

gaps: Agworld and John Deere Operations Center: the fetched docs describe field records and machine data only. No delivery ticket, weighbridge, grade, contract or invoicing step is described, and neither platform has a mapped operation for this job. No adapter built; a live account is needed to confirm.
Dock list check (driver checked against the inducted list before unloading): no mapped platform in the evidence. Agent skill step for now.
WhatsApp QC group (named on the call): WhatsApp operations are mapped in the kit, but this build sends the QC alert by email. Add a WhatsApp adapter only after the group send is confirmed.
Reading the paper docket (photo to fields): a person or the agent reads it and enters the fields in the shell. The kit has no OCR step.
Weighbridge weights: no mapped platform. Net tonnes come only from what the docket says.
Carrier payment and grower or supplier statements: not in the evidence and not built.
Microsoft 365 adapter is docs-only until a developer tenant and a real workbook prove the Excel table and mailbox calls.
The evidence file for platforms lists two platforms with no mapped operations, so the only adapter is Microsoft 365, the platform the call names.

evidence.calls: 1 discovery call (log and timber export receival, 500,000 tons a year across about 9 to 10 sites; manual docket keying by one or two office staff)
evidence.platforms: Agworld and John Deere Operations Center help pages: no ticket, weighbridge or grade steps. Microsoft 365: Graph mail and workbook table operations are mapped and checked against the vendor spec.
